body:
New ldap/ber.prn: read-ber-tag/read-ber-length/build-ber-tlv, the most foundational LDAP primitive (every LDAP message is a Tag-Length-Value element, RFC 4511 ASN.1 BER). Short-form length + low tag numbers only in v0, honest errors otherwise. build-ber-tlv uses an inline-c escape hatch (same concat-truncation reason as dns.prn). 5/5 tests, make test 345/345. Commit 0d3d059.

⚓ ☃
title: Real BER TLV primitives for LDAP (kanban 342332432423)
